preconditions.description: The number of people on the network excluding Bob must be between 1 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= n for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each number of friends must be non-negative and not exceed the total number of people excluding Bob.
The number of friends for each person must match the specified number of people.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not any(a_i == n for a_i in a) else ' '.join(map(str, sorted(set(a))))
postconditions.description: If no valid number of friends for Bob exists, output -1; otherwise, output all possible values of Bob's friends in increasing order.
